patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: No significant medical or surgical history.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: College student, reports studying for exams late at night. No recent travel. No history of alcohol or drug abuse.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with symptoms of food poisoning, taking into account the history of presentation and clinical findings.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I’m a 20-year-old college student, and about two hours ago I started having abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. I ate reheated food about an hour before it began, and I haven’t had fever or any other major symptoms.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling or pain. I’ve mostly just had the abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since it started.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on my body.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any trouble lifting my arms above my head—I can raise them normally without pain or weakness.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any loss of vision or any vision changes at all.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had a fever or felt extremely hot, and I haven’t been dizzy—just the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: Not really—I’ve been studying late for exams, but I don’t feel unusually stressed or overwhelmed, and the main issue is still the sudden stomach cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea that started a couple hours ago.

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any burning or discomfort when I urinate. It’s been mainly the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had chills—just sudden abdominal cramps along with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since it started a couple of hours ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast that feel fixed and don’t move when you touch them?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my breast area, and I haven’t had anything like that.” “I’m primarily dealing with sudden abdominal cramps along with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: Patient: It’s mostly centered in my abdomen as cramps, and I haven’t noticed specific pain on my sides between my ribs and hips. I don’t have back pain either—just the stomach discomfort with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have any calf pain when I walk, and it doesn’t go away with rest—I haven’t noticed anything like that. My main problem is the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since it started about two hours ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your urine looks darker than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed my urine looking darker than usual. It’s been mainly the abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea since it started.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any difficulty moving your arm up or across your body?
turns.patient_answer: "No, I haven’t noticed any difficulty moving my arm up or across my body—I can move it normally without pain or weakness."

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that your joints feel sore or stiff after doing the same activity repeatedly, like after a long day of typing, lifting, or other repetitive motions?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any joint soreness or stiffness after typing or repetitive activities—this has mostly been centered on sudden abdominal cramps with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea.”
